description: Get ONE instrument family's rows with per-field SEC citations — each figure carries the accession number, filing date and the verbatim quoted sentence it was read from, so every number can be traced to a filing. Families: warrants, convertibles, preferred, shelfs, atms, elocs, s1_offerings, equity_plans, exchangeables, recent_offerings. One family per call — request the families you actually need rather than sweeping all ten. 🔴 ROW-LEVEL WITHHOLDING: `withheldRows` / `withheldRowCount` mean specific rows could NOT be verified and were blanked, so every family total in the response is a LOWER BOUND, not a complete figure. Say so — presenting a holed total as complete understates a named issuer's dilution. An empty rows array on a covered company is a measured "none found in the filings read"; an unavailable response is not. 🔴 STATUS `disputed` (warrants / convertibles / preferred / exchangeables) means the ISSUER'S LATEST FILING DISPUTES THE INSTRUMENT'S EXISTENCE OR VALIDITY and its financial statements do not carry it: the row is SHOWN and EXCLUDED from every total (`summary.disputedInstrumentCount` / `disputedInstrumentShares`) — report it as a disputed claim against the company, never as outstanding and never as retired. 🔴 `contingencyTrigger: "event_of_default"` marks an instrument that converts ONLY on an event of default; it is still outstanding and still COUNTED — say "converts only on an event of default", never that it is not dilutive. 🔴 ON `convertibles` ROWS `principalBasis` says HOW `principalOutstanding` was arrived at: `aggregate_only` / `fair_value_only` / `conflict` / `undisclosed_since_issue` mean the current balance is NOT MEASURED (principalOutstanding is null) — report `principalOriginal` as the ORIGINAL principal with the balance undisclosed, never as the current balance. `conversionBasis: "formula_unanchored"` means the conversion mechanism is disclosed but no price input exists, so no share count can be computed — the row is unquantified, not zero. 🔴 ON `convertibles` / `preferred` ROWS `sharesIssuableBasis: "conflict_upper_bound"` means two filed counts DISAGREE and the filings do not explain why: `sharesIssuableIfConverted` is the HIGHER (principal ÷ conversion price, used so dilution is never understated) and `sharesIssuableIssuerStated` is the issuer's own printed figure. Report both, as "up to X; the issuer states Y" — never the higher figure alone as the issuer's count. 🔴 ON `warrants` ROWS a null `sharesUnderlying` beside `aggregateExerciseValueDollars` / `exercisePriceFloor` / `sharesCeilingAsFiled` is a DOLLAR-DENOMINATED or capped warrant: `summary.warrantSharesCeiling` is the MOST such rows could deliver — a ceiling (`≤`), never a count, never in `potentialNewShares`. `warrantCount` is a count of WARRANTS, not shares. 🔴 ON `shelfs` ROWS `babyShelfCurrentCapacityDollars` IS A STORED, DATED FIGURE, NOT TODAY'S HEADROOM: it was struck at extraction time from a float value that may be the issuer's own cover recital months old, less a takedown pool anchored to the corpus window. Always report it WITH its `babyShelfCapacityAsOf` date (`babyShelfCapacityBasis` says which float it rests on); a null date means undated, never current. For the raisable-now figure recomputed from the live float and 60-day-high price call `get_baby_shelf_capacity` — never present the stored figure as current. ALWAYS RETURNS 200 — read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. Coverage is partial: `not_covered` means THIS COMPANY HAS NOT BEEN ANALYSED YET, which is different from it having no dilution and different from an outage (an outage is a 5xx). Never report a company as having no dilution on the strength of an unavailable response. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED — it NEVER means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check, so decide from the accompanying availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. If a figure is absent, say it was not measured; do not describe the company as having none of that instrument. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` — a stale as-of date means the answer predates anything filed since, not that nothing has happened. Share counts are rebased onto a single split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro — without it the call returns 403 with code FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE and `requiredTier: "pro"`. That is a subscription-tier upgrade, not an add-on purchase; there is no separate add-on to buy.
